newtab.title: New tab
newtab.private_title: You are in a private window
newtab.private_body: Spark will not keep your history, cookies or logins when you close it. Files you download stay on your computer. Websites, your employer or your internet provider can still see what you do.
newtab.empty: Your recently visited sites will appear here.
newtab.widgets.spotifySetup: Requires Spotify Premium. Create an app in Spotify Developers, enable Web API, add your account to its allowed users, and register this redirect URI:
newtab.widgets.spotifyConnecting: Finish authorization in the external browser…
newtab.widgets.spotifyConfigure: Configure your Client ID in Customize new tab → Spotify.
newtab.widgets.spotifyConnectHint: Connect your account to control Spotify on your active device.
newtab.widgets.spotifyStorage: Credentials stay in your system vault. Linux requires secret-tool (libsecret), an unlocked Secret Service, and an external browser.
newtab.widgets.spotifyNoDevice: Open Spotify and start playing on your computer or phone.
newtab.widgets.spotifyInvalidClient: Enter a valid Client ID (32 hexadecimal characters).
newtab.widgets.youtubeHint: Shows the YouTube or YouTube Music video playing in one of your open tabs, with playback controls. No account is needed and nothing is sent to YouTube.
newtab.widgets.youtubeNothingPlaying: Open a YouTube or YouTube Music video in a tab to see it here.
newtab.widgets.youtubeSidebar: Also show in the vertical tabs sidebar
newtab.widgets.youtubeVideoNote: The muted video loads a second copy of the video from YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com) inside the card. It uses extra data, can show ads and does not work for videos that disallow embedding, where the card shows the thumbnail instead of playing.
newtab.widgets.error.youtube_not_found: The YouTube tab is no longer available.
newtab.widgets.error.spotify_access_deni: Spotify denied access. Check Premium, allowed users, and device restrictions.
newtab.widgets.error.spotify_no_device: No active device. Open Spotify and start playing.
newtab.widgets.error.spotify_configure: Save your Spotify Client ID before connecting.
newtab.widgets.error.spotify_reconnect: Spotify access expired or was revoked. Connect Spotify again.
newtab.widgets.error.spotify_secure_stor: Secure credential storage is unavailable. Spotify cannot connect. On Linux, check secret-tool and your Secret Service.
newtab.widgets.error.spotify_oauth_error: Spotify authorization failed. Check your Client ID and redirect URI, then try again.
newtab.widgets.error.spotify_oauth_timeo: Authorization timed out. Connect Spotify again.
newtab.widgets.error.spotify_external_br: Could not open an external browser. Windows requires Microsoft Edge; Linux requires Firefox, Chromium, Chrome or Edge on PATH.
newtab.widgets.audioBackgroundHint: Responds to audio playing in normal browser tabs. The visual fades out in silence. Does not change volume.
newtab.widgets.audioBackgroundUnavailabl: Audio capture is unavailable. Requires Windows build 20348 or later, or PulseAudio / PipeWire-Pulse on Linux. Protected content may provide no signal.
newtab.widgets.locationNeeded: Get your location to show the forecast, or choose a city in settings.
newtab.widgets.chooseCity: Choose a city to see the weather.
newtab.widgets.gmailDescription: Connect one account to see unread counts, senders and subjects. Message bodies and attachments are not downloaded.
newtab.widgets.notConfigured: Sign in to Gmail in the browser to view your inbox.
newtab.widgets.notConnected: Connect your Gmail account to see your inbox.
newtab.widgets.connecting: Finish authorization in the external browser. You can cancel here.
newtab.widgets.error: Could not update. Please try again.
newtab.widgets.error.network_error: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
newtab.widgets.error.invalid_response: The service returned an invalid response. Please try again.
newtab.widgets.error.rate_limited: The service is busy. Please try again later.
newtab.widgets.error.reconnect: Access expired or was revoked. Connect Gmail again.
newtab.widgets.error.access_denied: Access was denied. Check the account permissions and try again.
newtab.widgets.error.secure_storage: Secure credential storage is unavailable. Gmail cannot connect.
newtab.widgets.error.oauth_not_configure: Set up the local Google Cloud desktop client first. See the new-tab guide.
newtab.widgets.error.oauth_error: Gmail authorization failed. Please try again.
newtab.widgets.error.oauth_timeout: Authorization timed out. Connect Gmail again.
newtab.widgets.error.external_browser: Could not open Microsoft Edge for secure authorization.
newtab.widgets.error.location_error: Could not get your location. Try again or choose a city.
newtab.widgets.error.location_denied: Location access is disabled. Enable it in Windows privacy settings or choose a city.
newtab.widgets.error.location_unsupporte: Automatic location is unavailable on this platform. Choose a city.
newtab.widgets.error.settings_unavailabl: Could not load or save settings. Please try again.
newtab.widgets.error.settings_changed: Settings changed in another tab. Review them and try again.
newtab.widgets.error.invalid_settings: These settings are invalid. Please try again.
newtab.widgets.error.invalid_city: Enter at least two characters to find a city.
